scenario: Phishing email targeting CFO with personalized invoice request
email:
{'from': 'ceo@companydomain.com', 'to': 'cfo@companydomain.com', 'subject': 'Urgent: Approval Needed for Vendor Invoice Payment', 'body': 'Hi John,

I just got off the call with our supplier, and they need immediate payment for the recent shipment. Please approve the attached invoice so we can avoid any delays. Let me know if you have questions.

Thanks,
Sarah', 'attachment': 'invoice_0924.pdf'}
indicators: Email spoofed to appear from CEO's address; Urgency and pressure to approve payment quickly; Attachment potentially containing malware or credential harvesting; Personalized with CFO's name and recent vendor info from company records
risk: Potential financial loss due to fraudulent payment approval

scenario: Whaling email exploiting CEO’s recent conference attendance
email:
{'from': 'conferenceorganizer@eventpartner.com', 'to': 'ceo@companydomain.com', 'subject': 'Follow-up and Exclusive Offer from Tech Innovators Summit', 'body': 'Dear Emily,

It was a pleasure meeting you at the Tech Innovators Summit last week. Attached is the summary of sessions you attended, along with a special invitation to our upcoming private webinar.

Please review the attached PDF for details and RSVP at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Mark Davis', 'attachment': 'TechSummit_Summary.pdf'}
indicators: Email references recent CEO activity (conference attendance); Attachment may contain malicious macros or phishing links; Sender address mimics legitimate event partner domain but slightly altered; Request encourages opening attachment and clicking links
risk: Possible credential theft leading to data breach or network compromise

scenario: Fake HR email to CMO about confidential executive bonus details
indicators: Appears to come from internal HR but domain spoofed or compromised; Urgent call to action to click on a link for confidential info; Link redirects to a phishing site mimicking company login portal; Targets CMO with information related to personal compensation
risk: Credential compromise leading to unauthorized access and data leakage
